dct_description_sm:
The Town of Whitby Summer Maintenance map allows users to determine the frequency of grass and tree maintenance on Town owned land. Grass maintenance is differentiated between parks, boulevards, sports fields, high profile properties, open spaces and hydro corridors.

Map is used in the Town of Whitby Summer Maintenance Application

Updated November 2020
